title: Prior Courtesy Waivers and FlexLine Workout Relief
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — the prior-relief share follows the courtesy fee-waiver entries already on the line: one or more in the last 12 months give 0.50; none in the last 12 months but one or more in the last 24 months give 0.75; none in the last 24 months gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the workout relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent.

**Counting.** The entries counted are the fee-waiver entries on the line whose basis is courtesy, already on the line before this relief. A window of the last 12 months takes the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the relief date; the last 24 months, after the same day of the month 24 months before.

| Courtesy fee-waiver entries | Share |
|---|---|
| one or more in the last 12 months | 0.50 |
| none in the last 12 months, one or more in the last 24 months | 0.75 |
| none in the last 24 months | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical cases.* A courtesy waiver dated 14 months before the relief date and none since: 0.75. A courtesy waiver dated 3 months before: 0.50. A waiver on a Larkspur-error basis only: not a courtesy entry, so 1.00 if nothing else is on the line.
